plainText:
Clemont (Japanese: シトロン Citron) is an inventor who is the Gym Leader of Lumiose City's Gym, known officially as the Lumiose Gym. He specializes in . He gives the to s who defeat him.

==In the core series games==
 
Clemont is the fifth Gym Leader to be faced by the player. At some early point in the game, he gives a device that solves electronic puzzles to Shauna. He first appears outside the Prism Tower with his little sister, Bonnie, lighting it up. He will give after being defeated. According to the television show Gym Freaks, he is currently developing a machine that enables him to run faster, which is apparently his worst talent. It also states that he has secretly started to save money to go to the amusement park in the Unova region. He is described as a genius, having been credited with the invention of Super Training. Despite this, many of his inventions apparently fail to work.

Clemont and Bonnie do not appear in , though they are mentioned by some NPCs in Lumiose City. The Lumiose Gym was temporarily closed two years prior when Prism Tower was closed for renovations by Quasartico Inc..

===Pokémon the Series===
 
 
Clemont appears in Pokémon the Series: XY as a for , alongside and his sister . He and Bonnie first met Ash in Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!, but they officially began traveling with him in A Battle of Aerial Mobility!. He also reappeared in Pokémon Journeys: The Series for a two-part episode set in Kalos.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
 
==== ====
Clemont debuted in Charging After Electrike. He was first seen in Cyllage City alongside Grant, who was helping him find Pokémon to power the Prism Tower during a blackout. After witnessing , a famous racer, being found and taken away by several s, the two were left wondering what happened. In Fast-Thinking Froakie, Clemont found Grace's daughter, , and her friends chasing an Electrike on . After was defeated, it evolved into a and revealed it wanted Y to retrieve a Manectite stuck in a tree. Overhearing the commotion, Clemont introduced himself and offered to help get the Mega Stone in Y's place. Before Clemont could grab the stone, a Team Flare Grunt stole it and fled, causing a tree to fall on top of Clemont. and went after the Grunt while Y helped free Clemont, who revealed what he saw happened to Grace in Cyllage.

In Morphing Manectric, Clemont and the others were saved by Cassius, who defeated the Grunt's four . With the Espurr held captive, a curious Clemont took checked to see what was under their ears, causing him to be sent flying by the Espurr's unrestrained psychic power. The Grunt that stole the Manectite later found Clemont's unconscious body and captured him. In Shooting Frogadier, Clemont awakened in the Team Flare Secret HQ, where he was greeted by Xerosic, one of Team Flare's scientists. Xerosic freed Clemont from his bindings and ordered him to build a machine for Team Flare. Clemont initially refused, but was forced to comply after seeing Xerosic use his as a hostage.

In Quilladin Stands, the device was finished and given to Lysandre. With Clemont having served his purpose, Xerosic order some Grunts to throw the boy down an incinerator chute. Using his Arm's camera function, Clemont discovered the Secret HQ was located in Geosenge Town. Around the same time in Laverre City, X received a pair of glasses belonging to Clemont from a wild . Using the glasses, he also discovered where the Secret HQ was hidden and set out to confront Team Flare. 

In Flabébé Blooms, Trevor, , and made it inside the Secret HQ, where they reunited with Clemont and freed AZ, a giant man that was held prisoner. Clemont helped launch Trevor and the others to where the ultimate weapon's key was held, but they were unable to pull it out in time before it fired. To Lysandre's frustration, the combined efforts of X, his friends, and the Gym Leaders successfully weakened the ultimate weapon, preventing it from taking any innocent lives. AZ stayed behind to allow Xerneas to take Clemont and the others back to the surface. Once Xerneas joined Y, they attempted to destroy the ultimate weapon, but were interrupted by Malva and her . Due to Xerneas and Yveltal being evenly matched, Xerosic announced that Lysandre ordered a ceasefire. Xerxer confirmed this and retreated, taking everyone with it. 

In Pinsir Glares, Ramos revealed that Team Flare blamed the destruction caused by the ultimate weapon on the Gym Leaders and the Vaniville children. X and his friends were advised to keep out of the public's eye while the Gym Leaders helped rebuild the damaged areas. In Zygarde Agitated, Clemont, Bonnie, Alexa, Viola, and Yvette confronted Team Flare at . Together, the group managed to successfully free the Pokémon Team Flare had captured. After Team Flare was fully defeated, Clemont and his allies met with X and his friends at Lumiose City to congratulate them on their victory. He and Bonnie returned Furry, 's missing , to its Trainer. Clemont also gave Trevor Malva's Delphox, who they faced on Route 10, due to Furry recognizing it as an ally.

==== ====
Clemont was mentioned by Professor Kukui in Pokémon Move Specialist Professor Kukui as the one that invented the Rotom Pokédex.

Clemont's Japanese Leader title is .
In Pokémon Sun and Moon and the Pokémon Adventures , Clemont is hinted to be one of the people behind the creation of the Rotom Pokédex. In Pokémon Masters EX, himself and confirm this to be true.
